description: Export a Canva design and get Canva's links to the files (they last 24 hours), for an app that uploads them itself. To add a design to the media library, use canva_design_import.

as.description: picture: PNG; video: MP4 shaped like the design (1080p)

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

name: canva_design_export
title: Export a Canva design
